answers.query: What are my current automatic investment amount, schedule and fund, and what changed from my previous setup?
answers.answer:
Your current VTSAX auto-invest is $250 every two weeks into VTSAX.

What changed from your previous setup: it was previously remembered as $200, but you corrected it to $250; everything else in the recurring investment setup was said to be correct.
answers.reason: Distinguishes the erroneous remembered amount from correction, but omits the explicit 1st/15th schedule retained in state, instead saying every two weeks.
